title: Air Gear
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Junior high brawler Itsuki 'Ikki' Minami discovers Air Trecks, motorized inline skates that let 'Storm Riders' fly across rooftops. He forms a team with friends, battles rival skating gangs for territory, and climbs toward the Trophaeum Tower, the pinnacle all riders dream of. Over 37 volumes the street-gang story grows into a conspiracy involving the military and a hidden plan behind the technology.
life_message: Freedom, flight and a crew of friends are worth fighting for, and the sky belongs to whoever is bold enough to reach it.
